jobs.title: Vice President, Technology Operations
jobs.description:
BCI is working with an external recruitment firm. Please do not submit your application directly to BCI. Applications submitted through this site will not be reviewed.

To explore this opportunity, please contact Boyden . Only qualified candidates who match the requirements will be contacted.

Closing Date: Open Until Filled

Located in either Vancouver or Victoria (with a preference for Victoria), this opportunity will appeal to a leader who is energized by possibility rather than crisis. The mandate calls for someone with the attitude, curiosity and influence to challenge established thinking, bring people through change, and create a modern operating environment that keeps pace with an ambitious, AI-first business. The role offers an exciting opportunity to influence the future of BCI’s technology function and contribute to the continued success of one of Canada’s most dynamic investment organizations.

With $313.7 billion of gross assets under management, British Columbia Investment Management Corporation (BCI) is one of the largest institutional investors in Canada. Since its inception in 1999, BCI has grown significantly and is now regarded as one of the most influential financial institutions globally, investing across a broad range of asset classes and strategies in both public and private markets. Today, BCI employs more than 800 people across offices in Victoria, Vancouver, New York and London, and continues to be recognized as one of Canada’s Top 100 Employers, Canada’s Top Family-Friendly Employers, Canada’s Top Employers for Young People and BC’s Top Employers.

In recent years, BCI has made substantial investments in modernizing its technology operations and has established a leading-edge platform, recently winning Info-Tech Innovator of the Year (2025) and CIO of the Year (2026). With a stable and well-managed foundation now in place, the Technology function is focused on sustaining that momentum through continued innovation and the thoughtful adoption of new technologies. The next phase will build on BCI’s existing strengths by accelerating cloud-native capabilities, AI-enabled services, automation and modern engineering practices, ensuring the technology environment continues to evolve ahead of business needs and enables the organization to move with greater speed, intelligence and confidence.

Key to this ambition is the role of Vice President, Technology Operations. Reporting to the SVP, Technology & Innovation and CTO, and leading a team of ~32, the Vice President will oversee cloud and infrastructure services and systems, digital workplace services and systems, Service Desk and service management, as well as disaster recovery. This is a role not simply focused on day-to-day operations but on the continued evolution and shaping of BCI’s future state technology platform. The VP will be on the pulse of the external operational environment, actively assessing current performance and future trends, identifying opportunities for continuous improvement, and providing senior technical advisory services to the CTO for strategic consideration and action.

The ideal candidate will be a technology leader who has led large teams in a technology-forward, entrepreneurial environment such as fintech, technology-enabled services or complex organizations where modern infrastructure and exceptional user experience are viewed as business enablers. They will be a transformational and technically credible leader who combines strategic vision with enough technical depth to challenge assumptions and bring new ideas to the table. Rather than being constrained by traditional infrastructure models, they will be curious about what is possible, question the status quo, be comfortable leading change in an already stable environment, and focused on speed, innovation and the end-user experience.

BCI offers a competitive total rewards package which includes a performance-based incentive plan, comprehensive health & dental benefits, a defined benefit pension plan and paid time off.

The annualized base salary range for this role based in Victoria is CAD $190,000-$240,000.

The base salary offered to the successful candidate will consider a wide array of factors including but not limited to the individual’s skill set, level of experience applicable to the role they are being offered and consideration to internal equity.

We pay our people competitively in the markets in which we compete for talent and with consideration to internal equity and job structure. We aim for actual pay to be around the median of the market for target or expected levels of performance, and around the upper quartile of the market for excellent performance.

Actual salaries may vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors, including, but not limited to, experience and expertise.

To explore this opportunity, please contact Boyden .

We thank all applicants for their interest in this position. Please note that we will only be in contact with those individuals moving forward with our client.

jobs.title: Finance Director
jobs.description:
Location: Toronto- Hybrid (3 days onsite per week)

Yonge-Eglinton

Department: Finance

Status: Full-Time Permanent

Salary Range: $150,000-$160,000 annually

This role supports the healthcare brands across the FH Health portfolio (Pollin Fertility, Perennial and Wellness Haus). FH Health was founded by tech entrepreneurs to support Canada’s pandemic response with innovative healthcare solutions. We’ve since evolved into a leading health-tech company that transforms traditional clinic experiences by integrating diagnostics and care through technology. We are proud to support a portfolio of healthcare brands:

Pollin Fertility-A next-generation fertility centre revolutionizing patient experience, safety, and outcomes through advanced technology.
Perennial – Integrated primary and wellness care brought directly to retirement residences, improving seniors' health and quality of life.
Wellness Haus – A physician-led clinic blending evidence-based medicine with cutting-edge wellness care.

Learn more:
www.fhhealth.com
www.pollinfertility.com
www.perennialcare.ca

About the Role

We are seeking a strategic and hands-on Director of Finance to lead and scale our finance function and support the growth and expansion of the business. This role will serve as a key member of the leadership team, partnering closely with the executive team to drive financial performance, support growth initiatives, and shape the company’s long-term strategy. This role will also champion process improvements, automation, and the adoption of modern financial technologies, including AI-driven tools, to transform and elevate the finance function. The successful candidate will bring a forward-thinking, digitally savvy approach to optimizing workflows, enhancing reporting, and enabling smarter, faster decision-making.The ideal candidate is a designated CPA with strong analytical capabilities and a proven track record of building high-performing teams, optimizing financial operations, and enabling data-driven decision-making in a high-growth environment.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Leadership & Strategy
Act as a strategic advisor to the executive team on financial planning, growth, and expansion initiatives
Lead the development of long-term financial strategy aligned with corporate objectives
Translate business strategy into actionable financial plans and performance metrics
Support capital planning, fundraising, and investor relations as needed

Financial Planning & Analysis
Oversee budgeting, forecasting, and financial modeling across all business units
Review financial results and identify key drivers, risks, and opportunities
Develop insights on profitability levers, cost optimization, and revenue growth
Establish KPIs and dashboards to enable real-time, data-driven decision-making
Partner with operations and clinical leaders to align financial and business strategies

Financial Reporting & Controls
Oversee monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reporting processes
Ensure accuracy and integrity of financial statements in accordance with ASPE
Strengthen internal controls, policies, and financial governance frameworks
Lead audit processes, tax compliance, and coordination with external advisors
Accounting & Finance OperationsProvide oversight of day-to-day accounting operations, including A/R, A/P, payroll, inventory management and treasury
Drive process improvements, automation, and scalability across finance functions by leveraging modern technologies, including AI, to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and insight generation
Ensure compliance with regulatory, tax, and payroll requirements
Oversee financial operations across a multi-entity organizational structure

Team Leadership
Lead, mentor, and develop the finance team, fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement
Build and scale the finance function to support company growth and expansion
Promote cross-functional collaboration across departments
Act as a change agent to reimagine and modernize the finance function from the ground up, delivering strategic insights and building a nimble, high-impact team

Qualifications

CPA designation (required) in good standing
8–12+ years of progressive finance and accounting experience, including leadership roles
Experience in healthcare, technology, or high-growth environments
Strong background in financial planning & analysis, reporting, and operational finance
Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive strategic initiatives
Experience with ERP systems (preferably Odoo) and financial reporting tools
Deep understanding of ASPE and IFRS standards
Exceptional analytical, communication, and leadership skills
Hands-on, adaptable, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment

Why Join FH Health (Perennial, Pollin and Wellness Haus)?

You’ll be joining a mission-driven, fast-growing organization that’s reimagining healthcare with innovation at its core. This is a unique opportunity to play a leadership role in shaping the financial future of a company making a meaningful impact on patients’ lives.

Apply Now

We look forward to learning more about you. If you're a strategic finance leader passionate about driving growth and innovation in healthcare, we encourage you to apply.

FH Health is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law.If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are limited in the ability or unable to access or use this online application process and need an alternative method for applying, you may contact careteam@perennialcare.ca for assistance.We thank all applicants in advance for their interest in this position, however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

jobs.title: Director, Citizen Development & Employee Technology Experience Pod Owner
jobs.description:
Job Description

Location: Toronto, Winnipeg

Referral Level: Level 1

Mackenzie Investments

IGM Financial Inc. is a leading wealth and asset management company in Canada, managing approximately $ 310 billion in assets as of December 31, 2025 . It offers financial planning and investment services to over two million Canadians through IG Wealth Management and Mackenzie Investments.

Mackenzie Investments, founded in 1967, is a key part of IGM's business model, serving as a comprehensive asset-management partner for Canadian financial advisors and their clients.

At Mackenzie Investments You Can Build Your Career with Confidence
.
We are proud to be recognized as one of Canada’s Top 100 Employers for the fourth consecutive year and one of Canada’s Best Diversity Employers. Our vision and strategy aim to innovate the industry and support Canadians in achieving their financial goals.

Join our team to engage in continuous learning and skill development in a supportive environment. Experience the best of both worlds with our hybrid work environment, where you spend three days a week in the office, connecting, collaborating, and enjoying quality time with your amazing colleagues ! Our Values: Be better ; we strive for improvement in everything we do . Be accountable ; we foster clarity and are empowered to act responsibly . Be a team ; we are united to drive collective impact to achieve our goals .

Overall Job Purpose

The Director, Citizen Development & Employee Technology Experience Pod Owner is responsible for leading and advancing two connected enterprise capabilities: enabling employees to safely improve how work gets done through Microsoft Copilot, Power Automate and approved low-code/no-code capabilities; and reducing technology friction through stronger employee experiences, communications, onboarding, short-form learning, TechTalks and adoption programs.

This role shapes and delivers the pod strategy, roadmap, operating model, governance, prioritization and measurable outcomes. The Director balances speed, innovation and employee empowerment with security, privacy, risk, operational resilience and supportability, ensuring employee-led technology adoption remains practical, governed and sustainable.

Key Accountabilities

Lead the pod vision, strategy, roadmap and priorities for Citizen Development and Employee Technology Experience, ensuring alignment to enterprise objectives, portfolio priorities and measurable business outcomes.
Operate and launch and then continuously improve the Citizen Development operating model, including scope, intake, prioritization, decision rights, solution classification, lifecycle oversight, support model, escalation paths and value measurement.
Enable governed adoption of Microsoft Copilot, Power Automate and approved low-code/no-code capabilities, with clear boundaries between employee-led solutions and work requiring business-led or technology-led delivery.
Maintain practical guardrails for safe innovation, including solution registration, ownership, risk tiering, control gates, security review, privacy considerations and operational supportability.
Identify employee technology friction across corporate and advisor communities and sponsor practical improvements that improve productivity, adoption, service experience and confidence in technology.
Lead employee technology communications, TechTalks, digital learning content, short video learning, tech tips, onboarding support and awareness campaigns that make technology easier to understand and adopt.
Manage and refine the pod backlog, making informed trade-offs across value, risk, cost, capacity, quality, employee experience, technical sustainability and operational impact.
Coordinate agile planning, backlog refinement, sprint execution, reviews and retrospectives to maintain delivery discipline, transparency and momentum.
Provide day-to-day leadership, coaching and feedback to pod team members; partner with Product and Delivery Chapters on standards, capability development, staffing and best practices.
Build strong partnerships across business teams, Technology, Security, Risk, Privacy, Architecture, Service Management, enterprise platform teams and corporate support functions.
Communicate roadmaps, progress, risks, decisions, dependencies and performance clearly to stakeholders and senior leaders.
Track measures for adoption, employee experience, productivity, business value, cost, operational health, risk and supportability, and use insights to improve priorities and outcomes.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Technology, Digital Transformation or a related field required; equivalent experience considered an asset
5–8 years of progressive experience in enterprise technology, digital workplace, product, automation, artificial intelligence, employee experience, service management or technology delivery
Experience supporting strategies, operating models, roadmaps, governance frameworks and measurable outcomes for enterprise technology capabilities
Knowledge of Microsoft 365, Microsoft Copilot, Power Platform, Power Automate and related enterprise technology environments
Strong understanding of governance, security, privacy, technology risk, operational resilience and support models in a regulated environment
Ability to translate emerging technology into practical employee and business value
Strong communication, influencing, stakeholder-management and decision-framing skills
Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary work, manage priorities and coordinate delivery across organizational boundaries
Collaborative, pragmatic, change-oriented and outcome-focused leadership style
Passion for improving employee technology experience, reducing friction and enabling safe, governed innovation

What Success Looks Like

Success means employees can confidently adopt technology and safely improve how work gets done; technology friction is visible and addressed; Citizen Development operates within clear boundaries and guardrails; and leaders have reliable visibility into adoption, employee experience, business value, cost, operational health and risk.

The expected annual base salary range for this role is $149,500 - $192,500 which is determined based on skills, knowledge and experience and geographic location. In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for annual short-term incentive, health and well-being benefits, retirement and savings plan, paid time off and career development.

Benefits

Benefits
:

COMPETITIVE COMPENSATION & RECOGNITION: competitive base salary, performance- weighted bonus, education/career support, option to join Employee Share Purchase Plan with employer matching component .
EMPLOYEE BENEFITS & INSURANCE: competitive health and dental coverage, flexible plan for you and your family and short-term & long-term disability plans.
RETIREMENT SAVINGS PROGRAMS: voluntary Group RRSP enrolment with employer matching component .
WORK LIFE BALANCE: paid volunteer days, competitive time off including 10 wellness days off, WorkPerks discount program, hybrid & flex work arrangements.
INCLUSIVE CULTURE AND DIVERSITY: living our core values: Be a Team, Be Accountable, Be Better, engaging with community through Business Resource Groups (BRG communities are volunteer employee-led groups formed around a common interest, identity, or background).

IGM is a diverse workplace committed to doing business inclusively - this starts with having a representative workforce! We encourage applications from all qualified candidates that represent the diversity present across Canada – including racialized persons, women, Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, 2SLGBTQIA+ community, gender diverse and neurodiverse individuals, as well as all who may contribute to the further diversification of ideas.

Mackenzie Investments is an accessible employer committed to providing barrier -free recruitment experience. If you require accommodation or this information in an alternate format at any stage of the recruitment process, please reach out to the Talent Acquisition team who will work with you to meet your needs .

How to Apply:
Interested candidates are invited to submit their resume and a cover letter detailing their qualifications and experience to https://www.mackenzieinvestments.com/en/careers
.

Artificial Intelligence in Recruitment:
As part of our Talent Acquisition process, we may use artificial intelligence and automated tools to support activities such as candidate sourcing, application review, and interview scheduling. These tools support the recruitment process; all hiring decisions are made by people.

We thank all applicants for their interest in Mackenzie Investments; however, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

Please apply by November 12 2026.

jobs.title: Data & Analytics Consulting Leader
jobs.description:
N2P Systems is seeking an experienced Data & Analytics Consulting Leader to join our enterprise technology delivery team in Toronto, Ontario, Canada. At N2P Systems, you will put 10+ years of hands-on experience with Enterprise Data Strategy, Enterprise Data Architecture and Data Governance to work on mission-critical enterprise systems. This is an existing full-time, hybrid vacancy with N2P Systems.

N2P Systems is seeking an accomplished Data & Analytics Consulting Leader to drive enterprise transformation, strategic consulting, and business growth across the Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI) sector. This senior leadership position combines enterprise data strategy, analytics, artificial intelligence, cloud modernization, and consulting expertise.

The successful candidate will shape strategic client relationships, identify business opportunities, lead complex transformation engagements, and translate enterprise challenges into measurable business outcomes. The role requires substantial experience in Data, Analytics, AI, and consulting, alongside a proven record of growing business and delivering large-scale transformation programs.

N2P Systems uses AI to help screen and assess applications for this role. N2P Systems is an enterprise technology consulting and digital solutions firm operating across Canada, the United States and India.

Key Responsibilities

Develop strategic relationships with Chief Data Officers, CIOs, Chief AI Officers, business executives, and senior technology stakeholders.
Advise BFSI organizations on enterprise data strategy, analytics transformation, AI adoption, governance frameworks, operating models, and modernization initiatives.
Convert business challenges into actionable transformation roadmaps, investment priorities, and measurable business outcomes.
Facilitate executive workshops, discovery meetings, steering committees, and strategic client discussions.
Drive Data, Analytics, and AI business growth, covering opportunity identification, qualification, proposals, commercial negotiations, and deal closure.
Shape large consulting and transformation engagements by defining solution direction, value propositions, commercial strategies, and delivery roadmaps.
Lead RFP responses and proactive proposals, ensuring solutions are differentiated, commercially viable, and outcome-oriented.
Develop collaborative business opportunities with account teams, technology partners, alliance partners, and consulting practices.
Define target-state enterprise architectures and strategies spanning cloud data platforms, data products, analytics, AI/ML, Generative AI, governance, and Responsible AI.
Recommend modernization strategies involving leading cloud providers, data platforms, and emerging technologies.
Ensure enterprise transformation initiatives address scalability, security, privacy, resilience, cost optimization, and regulatory obligations.
Provide executive oversight throughout opportunity development, engagement mobilization, delivery, and business value realization.
Establish governance mechanisms covering project scope, milestones, dependencies, risks, commercial commitments, quality, and stakeholder communication.
Ensure effective transition from pre-sales to delivery, with clearly defined ownership, commitments, and success criteria.
Lead and mentor multidisciplinary consulting, architecture, engineering, analytics, and AI teams across different locations.
Contribute to senior talent acquisition, capability development, succession planning, and leadership mentoring.
Create reusable consulting offerings, reference architectures, case studies, estimation models, executive presentations, and delivery playbooks.
Represent the practice in strategic client, partner, and internal leadership engagements.
Develop strategic reference customers and contribute to sustainable revenue growth.

Required Skills & Qualifications

At least 18 years of professional experience spanning Data, Analytics, AI, and Consulting, with a demonstrated history of business growth and enterprise transformation delivery.
Strong expertise in enterprise data strategy, architecture, operating models, data products, governance, and modernization.
Demonstrated success in delivering measurable ROI and business outcomes across the complete Data-to-Insights value chain.
Strong understanding of data engineering disciplines, including ETL/ELT, integration, APIs, data quality, orchestration, observability, and platform engineering.
Experience directing enterprise analytics and business intelligence initiatives, including reporting, self-service analytics, semantic layers, and decision intelligence.
Broad understanding of AI, Machine Learning, Generative AI, Agentic AI, MLOps/LLMOps, Responsible AI, and enterprise AI transformation.
Experience defining and delivering enterprise-scale solutions using modern cloud data platforms and technologies.
Strong understanding of BFSI requirements, particularly regulatory compliance, data privacy, security, resilience, auditability, and risk management.
Established experience in consulting, business development, pre-sales, solution development, opportunity qualification, proposal development, and commercial support.
Demonstrated ability to lead large, geographically distributed teams and manage complex enterprise transformation programs.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Data, Business, or a related discipline.

Preferred Qualifications

Master's degree or MBA.
Experience with Azure, AWS, GCP, Databricks, and Snowflake.
Exposure to Agentic AI, MLOps, LLMOps, Responsible AI, and emerging enterprise AI capabilities.
Professional certifications in cloud technologies, enterprise architecture, data management, analytics, AI, program management, or executive leadership.

Apply directly at: https://www.n2psystems.com/jobs/REQ-43710

N2P Systems is seeking an accomplished Data & Analytics Consulting Leader to drive enterprise transformation, strategic consulting, and business growth across the Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI) sector. This senior leadership position combines enterprise data strategy, analytics, artificial intelligence, cloud modernization, and consulting expertise.

The successful candidate will shape strategic client relationships, identify business opportunities, lead complex transformation engagements, and translate enterprise challenges into measurable business outcomes. N2P Systems uses AI to help screen and assess applications for this role. N2P Systems is an enterprise technology consulting and digital solutions firm operating across Canada, the United States and India.

Shape large consulting and transformation engagements by defining solution direction, value propositions, commercial strategies, and delivery roadmaps.
Lead RFP responses and proactive proposals, ensuring solutions are differentiated, commercially viable, and outcome-oriented.
Develop collaborative business opportunities with account teams, technology partners, alliance partners, and consulting practices.
Define target-state enterprise architectures and strategies spanning cloud data platforms, data products, analytics, AI/ML, Generative AI, governance, and Responsible AI.
